pullRequest.title: interactive pr list
pullRequest.description:
this PR implements the interactive PR list we had in the original `cli-test` repo.

caveats:
- doesn't visually split out PRs
- doesn't explain what the contents of the list are
- doesn't support closing because i need to remember how to do mutations with graphql

it's not  ideal but it's something
pullRequest.author: vilmibm

summary: Adds an interactive flow to the root PR command. The new flow combines current, authored, and review-requested PRs, prompts for a selection, and dispatches browser, checkout, or cancel actions. Review selection-to-PR mapping first: displayed options are deduplicated, while action handlers index the original combined slice. This snapshot contains only the diff; no Go code or tests were executed.

sections.title: Select a PR and dispatch its action
sections.explanation: The new interactiveList function collects PRs, removes duplicate numbers from the displayed options, asks for a PR and an action, and dispatches through an action map. Verify how survey.Select fills the integer Pr answer: both browser and checkout actions use it as an index into prs, while the displayed list is deduplicated separately. The browser handler also discards the exec.Command(...).Run() error; check whether launch failures should reach the user. These are review questions based on the diff, not verified runtime failures.
sections.diagram: pullRequests -> combined PR slice -> deduplicated options -> survey answers -> browser / checkout / cancel

sections.title: Wire the root PR command to the interactive flow
sections.explanation: The root pr command now calls interactiveList and passes its returned error to utils.Check. This makes the flow reachable without a PR subcommand. Review the command entry point after the selection and dispatch behavior it invokes.
